# AI Software Technology — A Brand of Digi India Solutions

## Core Software Engineering Capabilities
- [Custom Software Development](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/custom-software): Tailor-made web applications, operational portals, approval workflows, and admin dashboards.
- [ERP Software Development](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/erp-solutions): Multi-branch inventory, procurement, production (BOM), GST billing, and MIS reporting.
- [CRM Software Development](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/crm-solutions): Lead capture, telecaller allocation, sales pipelines, follow-up reminders, and quotations.
- [HRMS Software Development](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/hrms-software): Employee records, biometric/geo-fenced attendance, shift rosters, leave approvals, and payroll.
- [SaaS Application Development](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/saas-development): Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, subscription billing, RBAC, and cloud deployment.
- [Mobile App Development](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/mobile-app-development): Android, iOS, Flutter, and React Native business and customer apps.
- [Website & Web App Development](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/website-development): B2B websites, multi-portal platforms, and customer self-service portals.
- [Attendance & Workforce Management Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/attendance-workforce-software): Factory shift tracking, gate-pass management, and biometric attendance.
- [Order Management Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/order-management-software): Dealer order booking, distributor portals, SKU catalog, and dispatch tracking.
- [Inventory Management Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/inventory-management-software): Multi-warehouse stock control, batch tracking, and reorder alerts.
- [Billing & GST Invoicing Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/billing-gst-software): GST-compliant invoicing, quotations, ledger reconciliation, and payment tracking.
- [Manufacturing ERP Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/manufacturing-software): Bill of Materials (BOM), work orders, shop-floor tracking, and QC.
- [Hospital & Clinic Management Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/hospital-management-software): Patient registration, OPD/IPD billing, e-prescriptions, lab, and pharmacy.
- [Hotel & Restaurant Management Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/hotel-management-software): Room reservation, front desk, housekeeping, KOT, and POS billing.
- [Logistics & Transport Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/logistics-software): Consignment booking, LR/bilty generation, fleet tracking, and POD management.
- [Field Sales & Employee Tracking Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/field-sales-tracking-software): GPS visit verification, beat planning, mobile order taking, and expense claims.
- [Retail POS & Billing Software](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/retail-pos-software): Barcode billing, split payments, inventory sync, and customer loyalty.
- [AI Automation Solutions](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/ai-automation): Conversational AI assistants, document extraction, and workflow automation.
- [WhatsApp Business Automation](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/whatsapp-automation): Automated inquiry responses, order updates, and CRM follow-ups.
- [E-Commerce Development](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/ecommerce-development): B2B and B2C online stores, catalog management, and payment gateway integration.
- [API Development & System Integration](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/api-development-integration): REST APIs, webhooks, payment gateways, and ERP/CRM/Tally connectors.
- [Software Maintenance & Support](https://aisoftwaretechnology.in/services/software-maintenance-support): Bug fixes, security patching, database optimization, and feature upgrades.
